description.value: Baby Doh's Mountain Fair is a mini-donut kiosk nestled in the village at Sun Peaks Resort, BC's second-largest four-season mountain destination. They serve hot, fresh mini-donuts made to order in front of customers, dusted with cinnamon and sugar. For cyclists riding Sun Peaks' extensive bike park or trail network, it offers a quick sweet stop right in the resort village.

address.value: 3185 Creekside Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0
